artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: NEW. isAnswerBearing(availability): the one gate. Partitions on Availability.producerState (the producer's five answer-bearing states render a body; QUEUED, RUNNING, UNAVAILABLE, FAILED and any unknown token render the panel). With no producer token, UNCERTAIN, the explicit unknown's view state, never renders, and a view fixture's other states are honoured (row W1-S55). Also exports businessDateOf(report): the status's business_date, or the view document's only when no status arrived. Imports the answer-bearing sets from state/status.ts; does not edit it.

NEW. The block at the top of every answer body: state label, business_date (with data-source-date-fact / data-source-date-from), reason code and text. The qualified presentation (PARTIAL, NEEDS-CORRECTION, UNCERTAIN) is an amber band carrying 'Qualified answer -- not a complete report', and it always carries a reason line.

The body is now gated on isAnswerBearing(report.availability). isCompleteState(report.availability.state) decides only data-presentation complete|qualified and the amber rule. A failed request now also clears the report, so an earlier answer cannot render under a failure. Header docstring re-stated for ruling H.

Only the claims ruling H changes. In the two PARTIAL tests, summary and account-detail flip from toBe(false) to toBe(true), and a data-presentation="qualified" assertion is added. Two test titles, the header paragraph and the STALE comment are re-worded. Each change is marked RULING H. The READY, STALE and benchmark assertions are unchanged.

AC2-AC5. Each availability comes out of parseIrEnvelope from a v1 envelope; the denominator is the producer enum read from StatusEnvelope.schema.json; the expected partition is hand-written. AC5 is a comment-stripped source read of ReportingTab.tsx, with an in-run control: a copy gated on isCompleteState must be refused.

AC6/AC7. The precondition is declared through fe-s-27/_dev-server.ts; the driver is spawned under node; four scenarios are served as v1 envelopes at the network layer. No seeding prop is named anywhere in the folder (0 'initial[A-Z]' hits in each of its 4 files).
The Playwright driver: the same interception, identity stub and Edge binary as fe-s-19's driver. Prints one RESULT json line per scenario. scripts/ui-smoke.mjs is neither touched nor called.
The v1 envelopes: data is read from fixtures/smoke/fe-s-18-frozen.json, and the status member is written here. business_date 2026-08-24 is deliberately not the document's actual_end, 2026-09-09.
